description: Validate any x402 endpoint the way buyer agents see it: calls it unpaid, decodes the 402 challenge (v2 PAYMENT-REQUIRED header and v1 JSON body), checks every offer (scheme, network, asset, amount, payTo format, timeout, fee payer, EIP-712 domain), CORS exposure and the origin's discovery files (/.well-known/x402, openapi.json, llms.txt). Returns networks, prices in USD and every problem with its fix. Price: 0.005 USDC per call, paid with x402 (USDC on Base or Solana, no account, no API key); invalid input is refused before payment and a failed run is never charged. Without a payment the tool returns the x402 PaymentRequired. Free sample answer: get_example {"tool":"x402_endpoint_check"}. Same tool over HTTP: https://yruz.one/api/x402-check?url=https%3A%2F%2Fyruz.one%2Fapi%2Faudit
name: x402_endpoint_check
title: YRUZ x402 Endpoint Check (0.005 USDC)
